aiDescriptions.n: No DBMS_CLOUD_AI procedure or console feature drafts comments or annotations. Select AI reads text you write. Teams draft with their own LLM job.

bulkMetadata.n: COMMENT ON and annotation DDL (CREATE or ALTER TABLE ... ANNOTATIONS) by SQL script. Annotations apply to tables, views, columns and indexes. No bulk API.

autoClassify.n: Oracle Data Safe, a separate OCI service, discovers and classifies sensitive data with 150+ predefined types. It does not feed Select AI.

sampleValues.n: No value sampling. Profile attribute case_sensitive_values only tells the LLM whether to generate case-insensitive string comparisons.

queryHistory.n: Select AI logs generated SQL in V$CLOUD_AI_SQL. Nothing mines that history to suggest joins, metrics or examples.

lineage.n: OCI Data Catalog, a separate service, shows table and column lineage for Data Integration and Data Flow jobs. No lineage view inside the database.

evals.n: DBMS_CLOUD_AI.FEEDBACK stores confirmed or corrected SQL per profile and reuses it as hints. 26ai only. No benchmark runner.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Write business meaning into table and column annotations and COMMENT ON text, then set comments and annotations to true in the Select AI profile. Add annotations with ALTER TABLE ... ANNOTATIONS (ADD name 'value'), and column ones with ALTER TABLE ... MODIFY col ANNOTATIONS (ADD name 'value'). Record good answers with DBMS_CLOUD_AI.FEEDBACK.

sources.t: Registering application data usage, schema annotations (19c)
Select AI release note: comments, annotations, constraints

bulkMetadata.n: COMMENT ON object AS or IS 'text' sets comments on columns, tables and views by SQL. Comment text is limited to 255 characters. No bulk import found.

sampleValues.n: MCP server tool qlty_distinctCategories lists distinct values of a column for an agent. No automatic literal matching.

lineage.n: Platform releases mention lineage but no docs page was found. DataHub's Teradata source extracts table and column lineage from query logs.

evals.n: No NL-to-SQL evaluation tooling in the MCP server README or docs index.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Write column and table comments with the COMMENT statement, one statement per object, from a script. Comment text is capped at 255 characters. The Teradata MCP server can also load descriptions, glossary terms and cubes from YAML for an agent. Draft text with your own LLM job and review it by hand.

bulkSnippet.code: COMMENT ON COLUMN sales.orders.status IS 'open, shipped, or cancelled. Exclude cancelled from revenue.';

aiDescriptions.n: Core PostgreSQL has no description generator. Hosted variants may differ.

bulkMetadata.n: COMMENT ON TABLE and COLUMN by SQL script. No bulk or file-import command. Any user connected to the database can read all comments.

autoClassify.n: The postgresql_anonymizer extension has an anon.detect() function that flags identifier columns from a name dictionary. Early stage, heuristic.

sampleValues.n: No sample-value or entity-matching feature in core PostgreSQL.

queryHistory.n: pg_stat_statements tracks statement statistics. It does not suggest joins, metrics or examples.

lineage.n: No lineage feature. pg_depend records dependencies between database objects, which is not data lineage.

evals.n: No NL-to-SQL evaluation tooling in core PostgreSQL.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Run COMMENT ON TABLE and COMMENT ON COLUMN for each object from a script that reads descriptions from a file or catalog. Read them back with obj_description and col_description when you build the prompt. Postgres has no AI generator, so draft text with your own LLM job and review it.

aiDescriptions.n: ClickHouse Assistant in Cloud generates queries, charts and summaries. No feature drafts column or table descriptions.

bulkMetadata.n: ALTER TABLE ... COMMENT COLUMN and ALTER TABLE ... MODIFY COMMENT by SQL. Comments show in system.columns. No bulk API.

autoClassify.n: No automatic column classification in the SQL reference or Cloud Assistant docs read.

sampleValues.n: No sample-value feature. The mcp-clickhouse list_tables tool returns column metadata and the CREATE statement only.

queryHistory.n: system.query_log records executed queries with tables and columns used. Nothing turns it into join, metric or example suggestions.

lineage.n: No lineage feature. system.query_log lists tables, columns and views per query, which is not a lineage graph.

evals.n: No NL-to-SQL evaluation tooling in the Assistant or MCP server docs read.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Set column text with ALTER TABLE ... COMMENT COLUMN, one statement per column, and table text with ALTER TABLE ... MODIFY COMMENT, from a script. Read comments from system.columns when you build the prompt. ClickHouse has no description generator, so draft with your own LLM job.

bulkSnippet.code: ALTER TABLE visits COMMENT COLUMN browser 'This column shows the browser used for accessing the site.'

aiDescriptions.n: No function drafts descriptions into the catalog. MotherDuck prompt() can draft text in SQL, but you must write it back yourself.

bulkMetadata.n: COMMENT ON for tables, columns, views and more by SQL, readable from duckdb_tables() and similar functions. No schema or database comments. No bulk import.

autoClassify.n: No automatic column classification. MotherDuck prompt_jev classifies text values, not columns.

sampleValues.n: No sample-value feature. MotherDuck prompt_sql reads schema and lets you limit tables and columns with include_tables.

queryHistory.n: MotherDuck QUERY_HISTORY (Business plan) records org queries for usage and cost. It does not suggest joins, metrics or examples.

lineage.n: No lineage feature found in DuckDB or MotherDuck docs read.

evals.n: No NL-to-SQL evaluation tooling found in DuckDB or MotherDuck docs read.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Write COMMENT ON TABLE and COMMENT ON COLUMN statements from a script, and read them back through duckdb_tables() or duckdb_columns() when you build the prompt. There is no AI generator, so draft with your own LLM job. Comments cannot be set on schemas or databases.

notes.text: A level 0 means the docs pages listed for that vendor do not show the feature. Pages without a source URL were searched but returned nothing.

The 26ai SQL reference documents the annotations clause, and the 19c application development guide has a schema annotations chapter with the same DDL. The Select AI annotations profile attribute is described as a 26ai feature.

notes.topic: Oracle Select AI feedback as evals
notes.text: The docs say feedback works only on 26ai with an NL2SQL profile and creates a vector index named <profile>_FEEDBACK_VECINDEX. Positive feedback stores the confirmed SQL. Negative feedback is refined by an LLM and stored as a hint. The page carries no preview label.
The Teradata COMMENT statement stores up to 255 characters per object and replaces any existing comment. Teradata items marked not checked have no confirmed answer yet.
The Teradata MCP server is MIT licensed and loads tools, prompts, cubes and glossary terms from YAML. It is a separate open-source project, not a Vantage feature.
